## Triage: first grade · `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:engine` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-15T15:55Z

Read fresh. `reassignOrphanedMetadata`'s view write-through (`if (type !== 'view') continue;`) has no `row.state` gate. Adopting a package-less **draft** view into Q makes the registry serve the draft body as live until the next restart, while `applyRegistryWriteThrough`'s own header says drafts "must never leak into the runtime". Measured at protocol level by #23646's dev.

**Grade p2:** an unpublished view served to users until a restart.

**Lane `domain:engine`** (`packages/metadata-protocol`).

**Order:** none. PR #23688 (#23646) merged at 15:48Z with the object limb's `row.state !== 'active'` gate, so this card mirrors that gate on the view limb.

**Scope:**
- An adopted draft view is rebound in storage only.
- **Pins:**
  - before and after adoption, the registry serves nothing for a draft view;
  - CONTROL: an adopted active view goes live, as today;
  - a boot afterwards agrees.
- Walk the HTTP door once.

`finding` leaves on grading.

The object limb (PR #23688), the D9.9 / `saveMetaItem` region (PR #23704, #23514) and the draft doors (PR #23706, #23657) are ⛔ not this card's. Plus real-kernel pins beside `packages/objectql/src/protocol-adopt-orphans-object-registry.test.ts`, and one changeset `.changeset/23690-*.md`. Stop on any other breach and explain it in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud` (the maintainer's order on seat post #6367: 「后续 重活开发 都可以单独开云卡」), `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (this run's `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` at `43d75ef27`: "no path-derived mandate"; a one-gate producer fix mirroring PR #23688's object limb)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: the risk is produced by `packages/metadata-protocol`'s `reassignOrphanedMetadata` view write-through, which admits a row of any `state` and so registers an adopted DRAFT view as live | no platform path covers it until a restart: the boot registers active rows only (`loadMetaFromDb`), so the leak lasts from the adoption to the next boot | an administrator calling `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/adopt-orphans` (ADR-0070 D5) in an environment holding a package-less draft view reaches it (measured at protocol level by #23646's dev, report 6194961346; the HTTP door not walked).
Thread-read: 6196345460
Serial constraints cleared: PR #23688 (#23646, the object limb's `row.state !== 'active'` gate this card mirrors) is on `main` (`cbe7712706`). The other in-flight work on `protocol.ts` is in different regions. PR #23704 (#23514) is in the object-ownership D9.9 refusal and `saveMetaItem`, and PR #23706 (#23657) is in the draft-discard receipt and is entering the queue now. Whichever lands second merges `main`. No other open PR or claim touches the view limb.
